name: ledger-action-identity
description: Add exact-once ledger action identity columns and their storage uniqueness boundary.
statements: ALTER TABLE casino_ledger ADD COLUMN action_scope VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' AFTER balance_after
ALTER TABLE casino_ledger ADD COLUMN action_key VARCHAR(191) NULL AFTER action_scope
ALTER TABLE casino_ledger ADD COLUMN action_fingerprint VARCHAR(128) NULL AFTER action_key
UPDATE casino_ledger SET action_scope = COALESCE(NULLIF(game, ''), 'core') WHERE action_scope = ''
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_casino_ledger_action ON casino_ledger (player_id, action_scope, action_key)
